claim: One language compiles through seven backends -- VM, C, native x86/ARM, LLVM, WebAssembly, GPU (CUDA/WGSL), and embedded scripting (Luau) -- proven to agree on supported programs.
attestation: All seven backends exist, are merged to trunk, and are held to cross-backend agreement gates (including a 220/220 transpiler gate and 4-surface bit-exact crypto gates) in private repositories.

public_traces.note: The WASM and GPU (WGSL) backends run publicly in-browser: a dependency-free .cl-to-WGSL compiler and a self-hosted compiler-as-WASM are deployed in the live demos.

how_to_upgrade_status: Planned: a public bounded example compiled through multiple backends with published agreement receipts. Deeper verification for counterparties: info@coherenceenergylabs.com.
limitations: Backend coverage varies by language feature; agreement gates cover the supported intersection per backend, not every construct on every backend.
